title: feat(product-catalog): report status to OpAMP server
author: cijothomas
body: Wires the product-catalog service (Go) to report its status to the demo's OpAMP server using the `opamp-go` client, so a Go SDK-instrumented app appears in the OpAMP UI alongside the Collector and cart service (.NET). Follows the same pattern as the cart service OpAMP support added in #3656. Enabled only with the observability stack. Now we have 3 components (Collector + .NET service + Go service) reporting health to OpAMP: Go service status:
